minutes.title: Launch Readiness Sync for Lumen v3
minutes.summary: The meeting addressed the launch of Lumen v3 on November 17, a price increase to $12/month with a 6-month grandfathering period, and a decision to reduce password reset link validity to 15 minutes. Key risks included a 4% payment failure rate and potential issues for users on slow connections.
